results.system_description: Fe atom, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 15 up and 11 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained network as printed; the paper does not describe a separate evaluation run.
results.notes: Isolated atom or cation, Table I. N_up = 15, N_down = 11 (M_S = S of the 5D ground term of Fe): not printed; inferred as the high-spin sector that the FermiNet JAX code used by the paper assigns by Hund's rule. A calculation in a lower M_S sector has the same exact energy but is another instance.

results.system_description: Fe+ cation, all electrons, clamped point nucleus, 15 up and 10 down electrons
results.eligibility_evidence: VMC energy of the trained network as printed; the paper does not describe a separate evaluation run.
results.notes: Isolated atom or cation, Table I. N_up = 15, N_down = 10 (M_S = S of the 6D ground term of Fe+): not printed; inferred as the high-spin sector that the FermiNet JAX code used by the paper assigns by Hund's rule. For a cation the code takes the spin of the isoelectronic neutral atom (Mn for Fe+), which here is that of the ground term of the cation. A calculation in a lower M_S sector has the same exact energy but is another instance.

results.notes: Geometry: the molecules 'studied in [43]' (Pfau et al., arXiv:1909.02487), whose coordinates and bond lengths are in that paper's Table II and Appendix G.
